interpretation: Exploratory warm-start study; partial crossing protection is not the original all-crossing target.

protocol.dataset: All free training decisions retained, including nonselected advice; no failure/outcome filtering; forced/terminal rows excluded
protocol.guidance: Guided only: local actuated requested-action labels on student states; legal PED and oldest pending age >=20 seconds; CE sum divided by all free choices
protocol.inference: Categorical actions with paired per-demand/per-junction random streams
limitations: Synthetic, assumed demand; no deployed signal claim
Four evaluation demand seeds and three parent replicas are a development study, not final five-by-ten confirmation
600-second training resets versus 2400-second evaluation remain different
Physical pedestrian stalls can remain; entry wait and entered-without-exit are reported separately
20-second threshold is an engineering hypothesis, not a pedestrian p95 guarantee
Short-spacing scenario also changes demand; it is not an isolated geometry experiment
protocol.observation_schema: legacy-v2; 42 local features; MAPPO critic has global state and horizon clock
protocol.parent_interpretation: Original MAPPO-control uses pedestrian weight 3; it is vehicle-efficient, not a vehicle-only-reward model
protocol.reward: Base -(queue+uninserted_due+3*pending)/10; tail/guided subtract sum of capped squared excess crossing age above 20 seconds
protocol.safety: Identical existing safe phases, occupancy clearance and collision checks for every controller
protocol.scope: Exploratory supplementary MAPPO fine-tuning; partial crossing protection does not replace original every-crossing criterion
protocol.selection: Final fixed-budget checkpoint only; all starting replicas; no checkpoint selection by validation or evaluation
protocol.training: Full parent actor/critic/PopArt state retained; fresh Adam, separate gradient clipping and parent KL common to all arms
